name: MESH-TECH-MD
description: MESH TECH MD WhatsApp Multi-Device Bot

HEROKU_APP_NAME.description: The name of this Heroku app (the one you entered at the top). Required only if you want to use .update/.updatenow.

SESSION_ID.description: Your WhatsApp session string, generated via the pairing terminal (QR CODE or PAIR CODE). Leave blank to pair on first boot.

BOT_PREFIX.description: Command prefix for the bot (e.g. . or ! or /)

BOT_NAME.description: Display name for the bot, shown in menus and messages

OWNER_NAME.description: Your name, shown in bot info/menu

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Your WhatsApp number with country code, no + or spaces (e.g. 254746844168)

WORK_TYPE.description: Set to 'public' so anyone can use commands, or 'private' for owner-only mode

TIMEZONE.description: Timezone used for scheduled features (e.g. Africa/Nairobi, Asia/Karachi, Asia/Kolkata)

HEROKU_API_KEY.description: Your Heroku account API key (dashboard.heroku.com/account → API Key). Required only if you want to use .update/.updatenow.

STICKER_NAME.description: Pack name used on stickers created by the bot

OFFICIAL_GROUP_INVITE.description: WhatsApp group invite link for your official support group (e.g. https://chat.whatsapp.com/XXXXXX). Used by the .join command.

ANTI_DELETE.description: Set to 'true' to show deleted messages.

AUTO_STATUS_SEEN.description: Set to 'true' for automatic status viewing.

AUTO_STATUS_REACT.description: Set to 'true' for automatic reaction on status.

AUTO_STATUS_REPLY.description: Set to 'true' for auto reply on status seen.

ANTI_LINK.description: Set to 'true' to automatically remove group links.

AUTO_TYPING.description: Set to 'true' for automatic typing simulation.

AUTO_RECORDING.description: Set to 'true' for automatic recording simulation.

WELCOME.description: Set to 'true' for welcome/goodbye messages in groups.

ANTI_CALL.description: Set to 'true' to automatically reject WhatsApp calls.

AUTO_REACT.description: Set to 'true' to automatically react to every message.

READ_MESSAGE.description: Set to 'true' to automatically mark all messages as read.

ANTI_BAD.description: Set to 'true' to automatically delete messages with bad words.
